verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator that serves local Ledger views, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows no OpenAPI or equivalent spec: probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and the docs mention no downloadable API description.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
